result:
I now have all the information needed to produce the review. Let me compose the findings.

Based on my analysis:

**Closed from prior rounds:**
- SAFE-MAJ-001 (not-applicable exits-0): fixed in fix-round-3 via `--allow-not-applicable` default-refuse (exit 2)
- SAFE-MAJ-002 (rename bypass): fixed in fix-round-1 via `--patch -- <path>` scoping
- SAFE-MIN-002 (dispatch-note/status-md symlink containment): fixed in fix-round-3 via `realpath` + repo-root checks on all three inputs
- SAFE-MIN-001 (slug collision documentation): closed at documentation level (D-044 + code comment added)
- SAFE-nit-001, SAFE-nit-002: closed

**New findings for this round:**

1. Fix-round-3's new dispatch-note/status-md containment checks are untested in failure mode (only branch-protection-log has a failure-mode test in case 19)
2. V1_2_0_CUTOVER_SHA unconditional computation (safety confirm of R1-CORR-001) — suppresses advisory TF-023E-002 warn on shallow clones
3. `--allow-not-applicable` residual operator-misuse surface
4. D-044 omits fix-round-3's new path-containment properties
